description: Hi! I'm Ambi. I love science, space, maths and storytelling. I enjoy looking at things from different perspectives, asking questions and turning ideas into stories. I believe even forgotten objects have amazing stories to tell! I'm looking for curious, creative teammates with skills in coding, science, research, design or storytelling. Let's bring forgotten machines back to life!
summary: We chose the Mars Pathfinder because we felt it worked great for the idea my daughter had in mind. To do a Diary as if the Rover had thoughts and feelings.
details: This is a storytelling project from my 10 years old daughter. This is based of a Diary were, Rover, Sojourner log their findings and thoughts during their first mission on Mars. He was left there, Forgotten but Not Lost. (File need to be downloaded and executed on a supported browser).
